# Dear ImGui

Immediate-mode UI framework used by Ellindyer World Forge.

## Required Files

Place the following files from the Dear ImGui `docking` branch (or a pinned
release) into this directory:

    imgui/
    ├── imgui.cpp
    ├── imgui.h
    ├── imgui_demo.cpp
    ├── imgui_draw.cpp
    ├── imgui_internal.h
    ├── imgui_tables.cpp
    ├── imgui_widgets.cpp
    ├── imconfig.h
    ├── imstb_rectpack.h
    ├── imstb_textedit.h
    ├── imstb_truetype.h
    ├── LICENSE.txt
    └── backends/
        ├── imgui_impl_win32.cpp
        ├── imgui_impl_win32.h
        ├── imgui_impl_dx11.cpp
        └── imgui_impl_dx11.h
